name: branding-hydration-powder-pouch-and-stick-packs-in-wavy-blue-on-marble
title: Pale blue electrolyte pouch and stick packs with a wavy royal-blue band and squiggle pattern on white marble
whatItIs: Four marble-backed views of a pale blue pouch with a serif 'first day' logo and a tilted wavy royal-blue band with white type 'RAPID HYDRATION ELECTROLYTE SUPPORT' and a lemon-lime image, three long stick packs with a blue squiggle pattern with lightning bolts, a pouch beside a glass and spoon, and a fan of packs around the pouch.
whatItMeans: Fresh and clean; a wave band and squiggle pattern say hydration and energy.
techniques: Use a tilted wave band to hold text.
Repeat a squiggle and bolt pattern on stick packs.
Show pouch, sticks and use context.

vocabulary.definition: A tilted wavy strip carrying pack text.
A wavy line pattern with icons.
White veined stone as a photo surface.
